== Research Notes ==
=== Father and family evidence ===

Rosanna [[Finley-134|Finley]] is separately assessed as his mother at 90%, because the 1925 account explicitly calls her mother of Finley and Stuart. That identification shares the stated child-identity limits; the two parent percentages are not independent probabilities.

The 24 October 1925 household interview records [[Finley-134|Rosanna Finley]], wife of Robert Glasgow, as mother of Finley and Stuart Glasgow. Finley is independently anchored to the Campbell-wife/Weldon family by the 1925 Ora and 1926 Samuel interviews. [[Glasgow-17|Stewart Steele Glasgow]] is the existing 1823 Adams County to Peoria account with exactly this named couple and brother; no checked alternative Stuart has that family. This explicit combined family statement strengthens the inherited placement beyond its previous name-and-generation fit.<ref>Josiah V. Thompson, Family Record, vol. 15, p. 101; Robert Arthur Glasgow household interview, 24 October 1925; library transcription, PDF p. 659. [https://uniontownlib.org/wp-content/uploads/2020/08/JV_Thompson_Journals_Vo13_thru19.pdf#page=659 Uniontown Public Library transcript]. Not a manuscript facsimile.</ref><ref>Josiah V. Thompson, Family Record, vol. 18, pp. 259–260; Samuel Steele Glasgow interview, 1 October 1926; library transcription, PDF pp. 1619–1620. [https://uniontownlib.org/wp-content/uploads/2020/08/JV_Thompson_Journals_Vo13_thru19.pdf#page=1619 Uniontown Public Library transcript]. Not a manuscript facsimile.</ref><ref>Josiah V. Thompson, Family Record, vol. 15, pp. 310–313; Idelma Ora Glasgow interview, 3 November 1925; library transcription, PDF pp. 759–761. [https://uniontownlib.org/wp-content/uploads/2020/08/JV_Thompson_Journals_Vo13_thru19.pdf#page=760 Uniontown Public Library transcript]. Not a manuscript facsimile.</ref>

The existing father is confidently assessed at 90%. 90% is a subjective confident assessment for the complete Stewart-profile/father pair. Stuart is the literal source form. The recollection supplies neither his age nor wife; identification with the later Stewart remains inferred and is less fully anchored than Finley’s. The informant reports her mother’s recollection. Thompson’s ensuing inferred upper pedigree, including a Robert said to die about 1806, is not adopted. No other alleged sibling or older ancestor gains confidence from this review.


=== Earlier father review, 22 October 2026 — superseded below ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-8]] is assessed at 79% (probable). Stewart Steele’s 13 April 1823 birth and distinctive middle name fit Robert Barclay Glasgow and Rosanna Finley’s Adams County family account, including the earlier William and Martha entries.

Probable specific family placement; a transcribed contemporary parent record is not held in this capture.

Next useful test: Find Stewart in Robert’s family register or probate child list.

Source basis already held: [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Glasgow-17 WikiTree profile export for Glasgow-17]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.
